address: Wodna Wieża, UL. Jana Kilińskiego 5, Pszczyna, 43-200, Poland

tags.name: Pets allowed only in outdoor dining areas (patio/terrace)

bio: Situated on the ground floor of a converted water tower, this is the informal little sister to Steampunk eight floors above. The influence of the French bistro is clear to see around the room, with simple wooden furniture and vintage-style colourful posters on the walls. The cooking has a similarly classic feel, albeit with a few Mediterranean influences incorporated too, in unfussy, generously flavoured dishes like beef tartare, bucatini carbonara and chocolate fondant.
